name: DataCleansingNode
label: Data Cleansing
description: Cleans text columns by trimming whitespace, collapsing spaces, removing special characters, and normalizing casing.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names to cleanse. Empty means all text columns.

fields.name: CollapseSpaces
fields.label: Collapse Spaces
fields.description: Replaces multiple consecutive spaces with a single space.

fields.name: RemoveSpecialCharacters
fields.label: Remove Special Characters
fields.description: Removes characters that are not letters, digits, or whitespace.

fields.name: NormalizeCase
fields.label: Normalize Case
fields.description: Converts the text to the selected case format.

selectOptions.label: Title Case
selectOptions.description: Capitalizes the first letter of each word.

fields.name: CleansedDataTable
fields.label: Cleansed Data Table
fields.description: The data table with cleansed column values.
